description: Frozen local-model matrix for RTCA Experiment B. All models use the same Ollama serving stack so model-family/scale effects are not confounded with runtime changes. Runtime measurements are recorded separately with Modelito.

models.rationale: Primary locally deployable instruction-tuned model used by the prototype evaluation.
Within-family scale control testing whether lower latency/smaller capacity changes restraint, grounding and policy compliance.
Cross-family multilingual instruction-tuned control; selected to test whether findings are Qwen-specific rather than to establish a model leaderboard.
